name: tma_forms
supersedes: protocol-v2.json (rules and installs stay; v3 adds the UBLKCP load direction)
purpose: UBLKCP covers two SASS forms the converter already tells apart for semantics (python/cyclescope/arch/*/rules.py): UBLKCP.S.G (destination shared, source global: bulk load, completes on an mbarrier) and UBLKCP.G.S (destination global, source shared: bulk store, bulk group). The timing leaves have no direction axis and carry the store knots (tmast.ublkcpgs). v2 r3i data on h100 show the load direction streams twice as fast at 16 KiB (slope about 256 cycles per op vs the store's 506), so the load direction needs its own leaf; the v2 load cell's U = 0 control recorded 0 (after the hang fix it no longer does a plain arrive + waiter spin) and b300 r3h has no load rows.
probe: tma_forms.cu UBLKCP load cell as in v2 with the U = 0 control restored to the tile cells' form (plain mbarrier arrive on [A] by the issuing lane, waiter warp test_wait spin, t_w), bytes 1 / 4 / 16 / 32 KiB L2-hot, U 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 (32 KiB x 8 omitted, shared-memory capacity), and the multicast load form (cp.async.bulk.shared::cluster.global.mbarrier::complete_tx::bytes.multicast::cluster, cluster 2 / 4, 16 KiB) for the dc >= 2 leaf; two runs, --launches 16 --reps 33. SASS gate: exactly U UBLKCP.S.G (resp. its multicast form) in the window.
derivation: v1 tile formulas: completion(B) = (E1 - o_s,1) - (E0 - o_s,0); service(B) = OLS slope of E_U over U >= 1; knots at the measured byte sizes
acceptance: v1 verbatim (se / value <= 3 % both runs, run agreement <= 3 % -> measured; else experimental)
model_change: new axis bulk_direction (values load / store) computed from the SASS destination.source modifier of UBLKCP and UBLKRED (S.G and S.S -> load: destination shared; G.S -> store), python and cpp converters identical; storage.async.service_start and storage.tma.completion get a bulk_direction partition under operation_class UBLKCP (load: dc 0-1 and dc 2+; store: dc 0-1). The partition change with the store knots copied into the store leaf and the old UBLKCP knots into the load leaf is the pure-refactor commit (cycles identical); the measured load knots are the semantic commit. UBLKCP.S.S (shared::cta -> shared::cluster) is a load-direction form but is not measured: the load leaf applies to it only if the run shows it in the corpus with a separate cell; otherwise S.S keeps the load leaf and this is recorded as an approximation in the source description.
install: load leaves <- load cells (source tma_forms.<device>.r4); store leaf unchanged; A/B 500 x 2 single-cluster against the other line's current baseline
not_allowed: no case-cycle tuning; no values from other machines; no threshold or derivation change after data

addenda.before_run: r5 (no data of this addendum's cells exists; written after the r4 failures, before any new GPU run)
addenda.item: Failure analysis of r4 (h100-r4h, b300-r4r5) from the run records and the probe source, and the corrections for r5.
addenda.observed: (1) b300-r4r5 tma_forms.jsonl: LDGSTS and STAS rows carry samples; every row from the first gather4 cell onward has n = 0 (gather4, scatter4, all UBLKCP load cells including the U = 0 controls, im2col); b300-r3h shows the identical pattern. h100-r4h skips gather4 / scatter4 (cc < 10): the UBLKCP load cells carry samples up to b32768.u4, then b32768.u8 and every im2col row have n = 0. (2) The multicast cell k_ublkcp_mc only runs under MB_UBMC and failed at run time on h100 (f913ffc); it never produced a row.
addenda.cause: (1) The probe breaks out of a cell on the first failed cudaDeviceSynchronize without printing the error and keeps using the same context; an illegal-instruction / illegal-address error is sticky, so every later cell of the process fails at its first launch. The first failing cell is gather4 on b300 (cause not established; it is not a cell of this protocol) and on h100 the b32768.u8 cell, which writes 8 x 32 KiB = 256 KiB into a 200704 B dynamic shared buffer (the v3 text already omits that cell for shared-memory capacity, the code did not). The UBLKCP load cells themselves are not shown to fail. (2) k_ublkcp_mc: instantiated as k_ublkcp_mc<2, U> for every dc (mask 0b11 for dc 4); thread 0 of every CTA issues a multicast, so every CTA's barrier receives dc times the bytes it expected; non-issuing CTAs never expect_tx / wait; the barrier init is not made visible cluster-wide (no fence.mbarrier_init.release.cluster + cluster barrier) before peers complete_tx on it; CTAs exit while multicast writes into their shared memory may be in flight; only U = 1 exists, so no service slope.
addenda.corrections: (a) tma_forms takes --cells <family> (ldgsts | stas | gather4 | scatter4 | ublkcp | ublkcp_mc | im2col) and run.sh starts one process per family per run, so a failure cannot reach another family; every failed launch prints the cell, launch index and cudaGetErrorName to stdout and the row is written with status unrealised:<error>; (b) the b32768.u8 cell is removed (as the v3 text says); (c) the multicast cell k_ublkcp_mc<DC, U>: DC is the template argument (mask (1 << DC) - 1); every CTA thread 0 inits its own barrier (count 1), fence.mbarrier_init.release.cluster, cluster barrier; per rep every CTA thread 0 does mbarrier.arrive.expect_tx(bytes x U) on its own barrier, a cluster barrier orders that before the issue, then only rank 0 thread 0 issues the U multicast copies (destination offset i x bytes in every destination CTA); every CTA thread 0 waits on its own barrier; t_s and t_w are rank 0's (completion_own, the v2 rule for dc > 1), the slowest peer's wait time is recorded as t_ack (reported only); a cluster barrier ends every rep; U in {0, 1, 2, 4} (U = 0: plain arrive, as the single-CTA control), bytes 4 KiB and 16 KiB, dc in {2, 4}; runs without MB_UBMC.
addenda.derivation_and_acceptance: unchanged (v1 tile formulas, v1 acceptance) for the UBLKCP load cells; the multicast cells use the same formulas per (dc, bytes): completion = (E1 - o_s,1) - (E0 - o_s,0), service = OLS slope of E_U over U in {1, 2, 4}.
addenda.install_rule_dc2plus: the load-direction dc 2+ leaf has one partition for every dc >= 2: if dc 4 is within 10 % of dc 2 at both byte sizes, the dc 2 knots are installed for the whole partition; otherwise the partition is first split into destination_count 2 and 3+ (pure-refactor commit, values copied) and dc 2 / dc 4 knots go to the two leaves. A cell that fails stays unrealised and the leaf keeps its copied value.
addenda.controls: r5 also reruns the h100 UBLKCP load cells: the h100 load knots installed from r4 (tma_forms.h100.r4) must reproduce within the v1 run-agreement bound; if not, the discrepancy is reported and no b300 / multicast value from r5 is installed until it is explained.
